mix_adjustment.interpretation: Baseline campaign maintains strong efficiency under common weighting.
Underperformance persists even under identical audience weighting, proving the 4x cost surge is driven by intra-segment post-click conversion decay rather than audience demographic skew.

experiments.title: Ad Creative Value Prop Realignment for Scaled Campaigns
experiments.observed_evidence: Campaign 1178 scaled budget to $55,662 and achieved lower CPM ($0.27 vs $0.36), but post-click approved conversion collapsed by 73.8% (from 9.22% in Camp 936 to 2.42% in Camp 1178), causing cost per approved conversion to inflate from $15.81 to $63.83.
experiments.hypothesis: Broad-reach ad creatives in Campaign 1178 set generic or misaligned user expectations that fail to convert on the post-click enquiry form. Replacing generic reach hooks with high-intent SMB pain-point hooks (e.g., 'Track daily udhaar payments instantly') will filter low-intent clicks and improve post-click conversion.
experiments.target_audience: Scaled acquisition audience (broad demographic, ages 30-49, top interest categories).
experiments.control: Generic broad benefit creative: 'Grow your business with smart digital tools'
experiments.variant: High-intent operational pain-point creative: 'Stop losing money to forgotten credits: 1-click ledger tracking'
experiments.guardrail: CTR must not drop below 0.012% (protect traffic volume)
experiments.success_criteria: >= +25% relative lift in click-to-approved conversion rate with p < 0.05 and no CAC degradation
experiments.expected_learning: Determines whether qualification-focused copy improves downstream unit economics at scale.
experiments.data_requirement: Impression, click, enquiry, and approved conversion tracking at creative level.
experiments.priority_reason: Directly attacks the largest source of cost leakage ($48.02 cost-per-approved surge).

experiments.title: Post-Click Landing Form Friction Reduction & Micro-Commitment
experiments.observed_evidence: Funnel drop-off analysis reveals that 92.6% of users who click Campaign 1178 ads drop off before completing the initial enquiry form (Click-to-Enquiry is only 7.40% vs 27.07% in Campaign 936).
experiments.hypothesis: The current post-click enquiry form requires too many fields upfront. Replacing the single multi-field form with a 2-step micro-commitment form (Step 1: Business category selection, Step 2: Contact info) will reduce cognitive friction and increase completion rates.
experiments.target_audience: All post-click web traffic from paid campaigns.
experiments.control: Single-page static form with 5 mandatory fields (Name, Phone, City, Business Type, Revenue).
experiments.variant: Progressive 2-step form: Step 1 (1-tap business type chip), Step 2 (Phone number OTP autofill).
experiments.guardrail: Total-to-Approved qualification rate must remain >= 30% (protect lead quality).
experiments.success_criteria: >= +20% lift in total conversion rate with p < 0.05 and no drop in approval rate.
experiments.expected_learning: Identifies whether top-of-funnel conversion leakage is caused by UX form fatigue.
experiments.data_requirement: Session-level form field analytics, step completion timestamps, and approval backend sync.
experiments.priority_reason: High leverage on 36,000+ clicks where 92.6% currently bounce without converting.

experiments.title: Audience Concentration & Budget Reallocation to Stable Interest Segments
experiments.observed_evidence: Segment stability analysis showed that 12 of the 28 interest groups evaluated have < 10 clicks, exhibiting extreme variance in cost per approved conversion, while top interests (e.g. ID 16, 27) demonstrate consistent sub-$25 cost per approved conversion across 50+ click thresholds.
experiments.hypothesis: Reallocating 30% of media budget away from unstable, fragmented interest segments into the top 5 sample-stable segments will improve overall blended campaign efficiency by eliminating long-tail spend waste.
experiments.target_audience: Campaign budget allocation across interest categories.
experiments.control: Fragmented broad targeting across all 30+ interest codes.
experiments.variant: Concentrated tier-1 targeting strictly limited to stable interest clusters with >50 clicks history.
experiments.guardrail: Weekly impression delivery volume must not decline by more than 15%.
experiments.success_criteria: >= 15% reduction in blended cost per approved conversion without frequency spike.
experiments.expected_learning: Tests the tradeoff between demographic scale and segment conversion efficiency.
experiments.data_requirement: Campaign budget split, weekly ad spend, and segment-level approved conversions.
experiments.priority_reason: Zero engineering required; actionable immediately within ad campaign budget settings.

experiments.title: Returning Visitor Personalized High-Intent Nudge (Consumer Behavior)
experiments.observed_evidence: UCI consumer behavior diagnostics show that Returning Visitors have a 3.5x higher purchase rate (16.9% vs 4.8%) and average page value of $7.82 vs $1.15 for New Visitors, but exhibit high exit rates (0.045) on cart pages.
experiments.hypothesis: Displaying a personalized re-engagement banner ('Continue where you left off + free merchant QR setup') to returning visitors within 5 seconds of session start will increase transaction completion.
experiments.control: Standard landing view with generic homepage promotions.
experiments.variant: Personalized sticky top-bar showing last viewed feature with 1-click resume CTA.
experiments.guardrail: Session bounce rate must not increase by > 2% absolute.
experiments.success_criteria: >= +12% relative lift in transaction rate among returning cohort with p < 0.05.
experiments.expected_learning: Quantifies the conversion lift of context-aware personalization for high-intent users.
experiments.data_requirement: Cookie/session identity persistence, on-site event stream, transaction confirmation webhook.
experiments.priority_reason: Capitalizes on high baseline intent with proven behavioral divergence.

experiments.title: Demographic Gender-Specific Creative Framing Test
experiments.observed_evidence: Audience analysis reveals Female segments generate higher CTR (0.024% vs 0.016%) but incur a higher cost per approved conversion ($68.20 vs $42.10 for Males) due to post-click enquiry friction.
experiments.hypothesis: Current creative hooks appeal to female SMB owners' visual interest but downstream product copy is tailored predominantly to male-dominated wholesale trade. Creating retail/apparel-specific merchant landing copy for female audiences will bridge the post-click intent gap.
experiments.test_variable: Landing Page Merchant Vertical Imagery & Testimonials
experiments.control: General wholesale distribution merchant testimonials and imagery.
experiments.variant: Retail, boutique, and local apparel merchant testimonials and workflow screenshots.
experiments.success_criteria: >= 20% reduction in Cost per Approved Conversion for Female cohort.
experiments.expected_learning: Reveals whether demographic conversion gaps are structural or artifacts of vertical misrepresentation.
experiments.data_requirement: Gender-segmented ad sets, separate landing page URLs, conversion tracking.
experiments.priority_reason: High initial click engagement indicates strong top-of-funnel resonance that is currently squandered.

khatabook_growth_loops.name: WhatsApp Viral Reminder Loop
khatabook_growth_loops.description: Merchant records udhaar entry → taps Send Reminder via WhatsApp → customer receives polite payment link + 'Sent via Khatabook' footer → customer (often another shopkeeper) downloads Khatabook. Every recorded transaction has viral coefficient K > 0.

khatabook_growth_loops.name: Paid Digital Acquisition Loop
khatabook_growth_loops.description: Vernacular Meta/Google ad → App install → Account setup → First 5 ledger entries → Daily active merchant → QR/Loan monetization → Reinvest in paid acquisition. Post-2023: spend more disciplined, optimized for LTV cohorts not vanity installs.

khatabook_growth_loops.name: Utility-to-Fintech Monetization Loop
khatabook_growth_loops.description: Merchant uses free ledger 60+ days → builds trusted cashflow record → experiences working capital crunch → Khatabook pre-approves non-collateralized merchant loan based on transaction velocity → interest margin expands LTV. High-margin lending offsets top-of-funnel CAC.

strategic_implications.observation: BharatPe's 5M+ Soundbox devices give it payment data Khatabook lacks
strategic_implications.growth_hypothesis: Khatabook could partner with device manufacturers for a hardware-lite QR payment confirmation integration, capturing ambient payment events that currently go unrecorded

strategic_implications.observation: OkCredit's retreat from P2P lending creates a gap in the micro-merchant loan segment
strategic_implications.growth_hypothesis: Khatabook could run a targeted acquisition campaign specifically in OkCredit's historically strong markets (Tier 3 UP, Bihar) with a 'switch from OkCredit' angle emphasizing lending access

strategic_implications.observation: App Store reviews flag unsolicited calls post-signup as a trust issue
strategic_implications.growth_hypothesis: Eliminating cold outbound calls to new signups and replacing with in-app onboarding nudges could improve D7 retention by reducing uninstall triggers in the critical first week
